full_page.content:
1935, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 56 Cont.
Oct. 19 Celeste Rabaut - about 21 - ruptured appendix (Provid. Hosp. ) parents on way to Philippines - said to excellent ... Enrolled in S.M.A. Thank God reported To-night better but not out of danger. (Oct. 22) Dec. 20 Thank God again - fully recovered - Parents to be home for X- mas. As yet they know nothing of daughter's escape.
Page 57
Oct. 21 Mrs. Clara Scheid - 48 - rushed to hospital with diptheria and Quinsy. Oct. 7 - two weeks To-day. Drs. feared death before reaching hospital (Kiefer). Enrolled same day in Ser. Mass Asso'n .... Now home since Sat. 19 and O.K.
Mrs. Merrit wants girl to help - during day only see ....
Ralph Ratke - 25 - in Eloise sometimes mentally weak - away from Sacraments 2 yrs.
Is it allowed to attend course of lectures on ... .by atheist? !
Jacob Miller - Jugo Slavia- 60 - 8 yrs. in bed, enrolled last June is able now to be up and around.
Page 58 Oct. 21 Chas. Whalen - 24 - quite singler case; Drs. have almost no hope. Seems to have brain Trouble - In fact had a part of brain taken ....
Helen Bruso - 13 - infantile Paralysis since 2 yrs. old - 9 operations (one for appendicitis)
Vincent Assemary - 3 - Infantile Par ...
James Faraci - work ....
Joseph Cyr - 29 - wants to sell store this week or lose it - has dia- betis - cannot work - unless cured.
Mrs. Viola Netkowski - 50 - extremely nerveous, fears long postponed operation - Enrolled To-night - decided to go to hospital Wednesday - operation Thurs.
22 Mrs. Ethel Messmore - Congregationalist - losing sight - operation soon expected. Enrolled Today 1.00
